evidence: Modifies the C kernel API header src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h to document behavior and concurrency constraints of btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks.
rationale: Clarifies API preconditions to help callers avoid unexpected process aborts. The PR documents that 'A second btck_chainstate_manager_import_blocks call on the same chainstate manager, while one is in progress, aborts the process', addressing an undocumented crash hazard in the public C header.
